title: Juicy Shattering Korean Chicken
description: A savory Korean dish featuring crispy fried chicken, cherries, and a side of spicy sauce, all cooked to perfection in a fondue pot. This shojin-friendly recipe is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat the rendered fat in a fondue pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully add the coated chicken pieces to the hot fat and fry for 8 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fried chicken from the fat with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess fat.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and korean chili flakes.
Add the cherries to the bowl and toss to coat with the soy sauce mixture.
Serve the fried chicken pieces with the cherry soy sauce mixture spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional cherries and serve immediately.
